# Working with the Kingdom

Every ride at Pimcore Kingdom starts with a **brief**: what the ride is for, who it is for and the limits it must stay within. The brief is a page in this portal, and it is the reference for every design that follows.

**Revisions.** A supplier uploads each version of a design as a new revision of the same ride, with a short note on what changed and why. Nothing is sent by mail; the portal keeps the one shared record.

**Reviews.** The park reviews every revision against the brief. A change goes ahead only once it has been approved; a change outside the brief's limits is sent back with the reason.

**Questions.** Ask early. The "Ask the brief" panel answers from the brief and the revisions, and the park's ride team answers what it cannot.

All names on this page are fictional.
